On the right, the Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2) extends her left arm, landing a straight punch with her black boxing glove on the mitt. The trainer (R1) looks on with a focused, neutral expression, while the boxer (R2) concentrates on her form. The background is filled with dark hanging punching bags and red ring ropes under cool overhead lights.
